summary.text: Andrew Hysell is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 48 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Hysell was born in Ridgewood, New Jersey, and earned a bachelor's degree from Carroll University in 1993 and a law degree from Georgetown Law in 2003, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Hysell said he lives in Sun Prairie, worked on Capitol Hill and for the Campaign for Tobacco-Free Kids while attending law school at night in Washington, D.C., and was twice elected an advisory neighborhood commissioner there.
He said that in Wisconsin he worked as a Democratic policy analyst in the state Assembly and then as an attorney at LawtonCates, S.C.

Hysell listed a state constitutional amendment creating an individual right to privacy, shifting public education funding from localities to the state, and support for organized labor among his key campaign messages in that survey.
Hysell was assigned to the Constitution and Ethics Committee, the Judiciary Committee and the Rules Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
